findings.text: non-blocking: preserve_discard_record writes the spool marker before the launch is attempted and never withdraws it if the launch succeeds, so a request discarded mid-pass that nevertheless launches leaves a durable discard record beside a live run; promotion.discard_recorded then answers true for that run and recovery_watch.py:1625 words its later departure as discarded rather than withdrawn. The manifest's outside_scope names the launch-proceeds window but not this side effect; closing it needs dispatch_claims.py, outside this node's write paths.

VERDICT done_when: the done_when names tests/test_a_discarded_request_stays_discarded.py passing at head with a base arm and a reverted-repair control; the manifest records base c11e89e83 2 failed / 3 passed EXIT=1 (logs/base-gate.log) and head 300473b4e 5 passed EXIT=0 (logs/head-gate.log), which is the measure the gate asserts.
VERDICT write_paths: the manifest declares reckon/crew/promotion.py, reckon/crew/queue_admission.py, tests/test_a_discarded_request_stays_discarded.py, docs/evidence/fragments/the-suite-is-green-at-head/a-mid-pass-discard-survives-the-rollback.html and docs/figures/the-suite-is-green-at-head/; git diff c11e89e83..a249ff84c changes only the two source files and the evidence fragment, all inside that set.
VERDICT manifest: read; it records the probe trace, both git-archive arms, the importer population, the executed negative control, the ruff position and status complete.
VERDICT diff: read both commits against the base; 300473b4e adds preserve_discard_record (reckon/crew/promotion.py:1845-1872) and its single call (reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:232-237), a249ff84c adds the 57-line evidence fragment, and no test is modified, skipped or weakened.

SCORE durability: 19
JUSTIFICATION durability: the run adds no assertion, and the guard it relies on is disproved-in-reverse rather than assumed: logs/negative-control.log restores both files to the base revision and the two ids fail again (2 failed, EXIT=1), so the pre-existing tests at tests/test_a_discarded_request_stays_discarded.py:69 and :119 redden if preserve_discard_record is removed.
SCORE fit: 18
JUSTIFICATION fit: reckon/crew/queue_admission.py:235 uses the module's existing function-local import idiom for promotion (compare :832 and :1871) and promotion.py:1845 names the mechanism, with no plan label or version in the symbol, file or docstring.
SCORE reuse: 18
JUSTIFICATION reuse: the capability search over reckon/crew found no owner for copying a discard marker into the spool; the new function reuses the existing discard_record_path (promotion.py:1817), discard_spool_path (:1840) and _write_json rather than reimplementing them, and leaves the create-time path in _write_discard_record (:1961) untouched.
FINDING reckon/crew/promotion.py:1871 non-blocking: preserve_discard_record writes the spool marker before the launch is attempted and never withdraws it if the launch succeeds, so a request discarded mid-pass that nevertheless launches leaves a durable discard record beside a live run, and promotion.discard_recorded (promotion.py:1845) then answers true for it, which recovery_watch.py:1625 reads as a discarded departure; the manifest's outside_scope names the launch-proceeds window but not this side effect.
